description.content: Seamless connect: trust the Deskpin publisher once (a single admin click in Info) and remote sessions open with no Windows security prompt, even with full resource redirection.
Per-machine redirection settings: choose exactly what to redirect — Clipboard, Printers, Audio, Microphone, Drives, WebAuthn, Camera, Smart cards. Only what you tick is requested.
Automatic updates in-app: Deskpin downloads the new version with a progress bar and installs it in place, then relaunches — no browser needed.
Activity log: a new page listing recent remote sessions, automatic layout re-maps and blocked (unreachable) attempts.
Info page: app version, What's new, check-for-updates, and the seamless-connect setup all in one place.
Clean uninstall: removes the signing certificate, stored credentials, registry entries, the database and all app data.
New app icon (white monitor outline with a teal pin, transparent background) and a compact, DPI-aware window.
